gold-museum.name: Gold Museum
gold-museum.price_text: Small entry fee; free on Sundays — check on the day
gold-museum.hours: Tue–Sat roughly 09:00–18:00 · Sun until about 16:00 · closed Monday
gold-museum.tip: Go early or on a Sunday. The underground vault rooms are the highlight.
gold-museum.best: Weekday morning; Sunday is free but crowded

monserrate.name: Monserrate Sanctuary
monserrate.price_text: Cable car, funicular or stairs — pay per ride; check prices on the day
monserrate.hours: Roughly 06:30–midnight; last ascent earlier — check on the day
monserrate.tip: Go on a clear morning for the best city view. Avoid weekends after midday.

la-candelaria.name: La Candelaria
la-candelaria.tip: Wander the colonial streets on a weekday and keep your phone out of sight.

plaza-bolivar.name: Plaza de Bolivar
plaza-bolivar.tip: The square is surrounded by government buildings; visit in daylight and watch your belongings.

botero-museum.name: Botero Museum
botero-museum.hours: Tue–Sat roughly 09:00–19:00 · Sun until about 17:00 · closed Monday
botero-museum.tip: Free and compact — pair it with the Gold Museum nearby.

teatro-colon.name: Teatro Colon, Bogota
teatro-colon.price_text: Guided tours and shows priced separately — check on the day
teatro-colon.hours: Box office daytime; tours on set times — check on the day
teatro-colon.tip: Book a guided tour ahead if you want to see the interior.

casa-narino.name: Casa de Nariño
casa-narino.hours: Limited visiting hours — check on the day
casa-narino.tip: It is the presidential palace; visits are restricted, so confirm before you go.

divercity.name: Divercity
divercity.price_text: Paid entry for children — check on the day
divercity.hours: Family attraction hours — check on the day
divercity.tip: A kids' role-play park; best for families with young children.

la-chorrera.name: La Chorrera Falls
la-chorrera.price_text: Entry and transport cost — check on the day
la-chorrera.tip: A day trip outside the city; bring layers and sturdy shoes.

mundo-aventura.name: Mundo Aventura
mundo-aventura.price_text: Paid rides and entry — check on the day
mundo-aventura.hours: Amusement park hours — check on the day
mundo-aventura.tip: A theme park for families; check opening days before travelling out.

parque-jaime-duque.name: Parque Jaime Duque
parque-jaime-duque.price_text: Paid entry — check on the day
parque-jaime-duque.hours: Daytime; closed some weekdays — check on the day
parque-jaime-duque.tip: A large park north of the city; plan a half day and check transport.

salitre-magico.name: Salitre Magico
salitre-magico.price_text: Paid entry and rides — check on the day
salitre-magico.hours: Amusement park hours — check on the day
salitre-magico.tip: A city amusement park; good for families with kids.

tequendama-falls.name: Tequendama Falls
tequendama-falls.price_text: Entry and transport cost — check on the day
tequendama-falls.tip: A half-day trip southwest of Bogotá; go with a guide or organised tour.

virgilio-barco.name: Virgilio Barco Library
virgilio-barco.hours: Library hours — check on the day
virgilio-barco.tip: A striking modern building and park; good for a quiet hour.

paloquemao.name: Mercado de Paloquemao
paloquemao.price_text: Free to enter; pay for food
paloquemao.hours: Early morning to afternoon — check on the day
paloquemao.tip: Go early for fruit, juices and local snacks. Bring small cash.

zona-g.name: Zona G food walk
zona-g.tip: A cluster of good restaurants; book ahead for dinner.

zona-rosa-walk.name: Zona Rosa evening walk
zona-rosa-walk.price_text: Free to walk; pay for drinks
zona-rosa-walk.tip: Bars and restaurants; stay on busy streets and keep valuables close.

graffiti-tour.name: Graffiti and street art tour
graffiti-tour.price_text: Paid guided tour — check on the day
graffiti-tour.tip: Book a small-group tour to learn the local street-art scene.

ciclovia.name: Ciclovía Sunday bike ride
ciclovia.tip: Major roads close to cars on Sunday mornings; rent a bike and join in.

usaquen-market.name: Usaquén flea market
usaquen-market.price_text: Free to browse; pay for food and crafts
usaquen-market.hours: Mainly weekends — check on the day
usaquen-market.tip: Crafts, food stalls and a colonial square; go on a Sunday.

cerro-guadalupe.name: Cerro de Guadalupe viewpoint
cerro-guadalupe.price_text: Transport cost — check on the day
cerro-guadalupe.tip: A high viewpoint over the city; go on a clear day and arrange transport back.
